The known results establish linear independence of all positive‑characteristic multiple zeta values of a given weight up to weight \(q\); the first non‑trivial \(\mathbb{F}_q\)-linear relation among them appears at weight \(q+1\). Hence the maximal weight for which independence is guaranteed for every weight \(\le w_{\max}\) is  

\[
w_{\max}=q .
\]

**ANSWER:** q
